registration_scope: Filename, bytes, hash and container metadata only. Gameplay content not inspected before registration.

duplicate_check.method: Sparse whole-frame pHash (32x32 DCT, 8x8 binary signature) at 2-3s cadence, comparing Hamming distance <=8 across sampled frames and checking for a consistent temporal alignment.

known_source_results.comment: One isolated similar frame; no matching sequence.

equivalent_prior_library_upload.interpretation: Same underlying 11-07 match as the uploaded compressed file, but no evidence that this recording was used to build or tune the candidate.

duplicate_check.scope_limit: Compared with the five accessible known historical recordings and documented fixture source names; absence of a detected match is not an exhaustive repository usage proof.

candidate_authority_invalidation.ledger_branch_checker_scope: Authority ledger HEAD lacks the intervening candidate-live production changes; checker CURRENT on ledger HEAD must not be treated as candidate-live verification.

against_candidate_live.rule: At least one invalidation_path changed from old evidence SHA to fixed candidate SHA. Does not retroactively disprove the earlier device observations.

eligible_checks: no stale presentation or replay seek mismatch
ineligible_negative_checks: missed recognition of small cards or HUD due to compression
failure to produce CHAIN_OK where no qualified observable window exists
compressed_source.interpretation: Missing recognitions from this resized source are not candidate FAIL and do not prove cross-video recognition generalization. A wrong positive, unsupported coach or structural defect still counts.

original_source.registration_rule: Compute filename, byte length and SHA-256, and append identity to this Ledger record before any iPhone run on the original. Verify it represents the same 2026-11-07 match before reusing the video-only Oracle.

one_run_can_verify_prior_correctives_onl: natural wording of chained confirmed move
Review Card displays provenance of pre-action EP carry without overwriting raw before-state unknown
device_acceptance_policy.no_implicit_confirmation: A valid 20/20 runtime attestation or absence of a relevant scene does not by itself confirm each behavior correction.

oracle_evidence_policy.conflict_rule: Do not declare the candidate or oracle correct upon a disagreement. Re-inspect the exact video frame(s), and use original recording if compressed source is insufficient; leave unresolved if still ambiguous.
oracle_evidence_policy.hp_guard_check: Compare visible HP at time anchors and intermediate contiguous frames. Check BOTH suppression of real heal/damage transitions and acceptance of animation/transient readings. No implied effect-source identification.
